regulator.name: Data Protection Board of India (on constitution)

instruments.name: Information Technology Act, 2000 and the SPDI Rules, 2011
CERT-In Directions of 28 April 2022 on cyber incident reporting

facet_hints.commencement: The DPDP Act 2023 commences in stages by notification, and the rules matter as much as the Act. Establish precisely which provisions are in force on today's date before reporting an obligation as binding — this is the single most important retrieval task in this pack.
facet_hints.consent_notice: The Act is consent-forward, with an itemised notice requirement and Consent Manager machinery.
facet_hints.children: Verifiable parental consent for under-18s, and a prohibition on tracking and targeted advertising directed at children.
facet_hints.breach_notification: Personal data breach intimation to the Board and to affected Data Principals; note the separate and much shorter CERT-In 6-hour incident reporting direction.
facet_hints.enforcement: The Act sets financial penalties in a schedule; retrieve the schedule rather than recalling figures.

seed_obligations.title: Give an itemised notice and obtain consent for each specified purpose
applies_when: processes digital personal data of Data Principals in India
testable_as: an itemised notice at the point of collection
a withdrawal path as easy as the grant

seed_obligations.title: Obtain verifiable parental consent and do not track or target children
applies_when: processes personal data of a person under 18
testable_as: no behavioural tracking or targeted advertising for child accounts

seed_obligations.title: Intimate the Board and affected Data Principals of a personal data breach
testable_as: an incident runbook covering both the Board and CERT-In timelines

seed_obligations.title: Report specified cyber incidents to CERT-In within six hours
applies_when: operates a service reachable from India and suffers a listed incident type
testable_as: a runbook with the six-hour clock
synchronised system clocks to NTP as the directions require
logs retained for the specified period
